The '''''Hunter''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that served in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Hunter'' saw service in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was dispatched from [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to a Republic supply base for supplies and reinforcements.
